title: What If Earth Suddenly Stopped Spinning?

scenes.text: What if Earth suddenly stopped spinning? You're moving at 1,000 miles an hour right now.
At the equator, the ground turns at about 1,037 miles an hour. At the poles, it's zero.
Stop the planet and everything not bolted down would keep going: air, oceans, and people.
Winds over 1,000 miles an hour would sweep the equator, nearly five times the fastest surface wind ever recorded.
The oceans would surge toward the poles, flooding coasts as the planet rounded out.
Then the real change: with no spin, each day and night would last about six months.

description:
